messages:
zoe: Heads-up  mini webinar tomorrow. Need a short social push: X teaser, LinkedIn long-thread, 30s clip. Who takes copy + asset QA?
marta: I can do captions and the LinkedIn thread. Need final clip mp4, transcript, and a thumbnail (16:9).
liam: Ops will export the clip + transcript by 10:00 PT. @marta I can make 3 thumbnails and a 10s GIF, deliver by 11:15.
zoe: Schedule: X teaser 09:00 PT, LinkedIn thread 12:00 PT, clip follow-up +24h. Approval cutoff 08:45 PT.
marta: Messaging question: lead with benchmark stat or customer quote? Benchmarks strong but legal might delay. Suggest anonymized stat backup ("~2x cost reduction").
liam: I'll design a LinkedIn hero image with an anonymized callout so we can swap copy without redesign.
post-bot: Drafts queued: X teaser (09:00 PT), LinkedIn thread (12:00 PT). Will publish if approvals present by 08:45 PT.
zoe: Routing: tag signups "mini-web-2026". UTMs: source=social_x / source=social_li. SDRs get Slack ping + email.
marta: Engagement plan: reply to top 5 comments within first hour; promote one strong comment into a quote post. I'll own replies first 45m then hand to community.
liam: Assets uploaded to /shared/marketing/assets/mini-web-2026 by 11:15. Will drop links here.
zoe: Approval flow: marta -> liam -> legal (if numbers). If legal not back by 08:45, remove hard numbers and proceed. Quick 15m postmortem tomorrow 10:00 PT to iterate messaging based on CTR & CPL.
post-bot: Once final_approval=YES, scheduled posts will go live at set times.
